clues: This port town sits on a bay on the north shore of its land. Its shore looks out on a wide gulf of the Baltic Sea.
Summers here are warm and wet, and rain falls through the warm months. Winters here are cold, and snow lies deep on the ground.
That note of freedom was read out loud in this town on 24 Feb 1918. The new free land then made this town its chief town.
This town's old core has kept its look from the days of knights more than most in Europe. It sits on the world list of great sites that must be kept safe.
Estonia is run from this town, and the work of state is done here. More folk live in this port town than in any town in the land.
